# Tandem — Couples Organizer App

> Tandem is a free mobile app (iOS & Android) that helps couples organize their shared life. It combines shared to-do lists, a shared calendar, and shared expense tracking into one app built specifically for two people.

Tandem replaces the need to juggle multiple apps for shared tasks, calendars, expenses, routines, and weekly relationship check-ins. It is currently free on iOS and Android.

## Core Features

- **Shared Todos**: Create and manage task lists together with real-time sync. Assign tasks, set due dates, and track completion.
- **Shared Calendar**: Coordinate schedules, plan events together, and never miss important dates. Both partners see updates instantly.
- **Shared Finances**: Track shared expenses, split costs, and manage budgets together with full transparency.

## Who It's For

Tandem is designed for couples (dating, engaged, married, or cohabiting) who want to stay organized together. It also works for roommates or any two people sharing a household.

## Download

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tandem-for-couples/id6758865751
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thebrunix.tandem

## Guides

Tandem publishes free, in-depth planning guides for couples:

- [How to Split Expenses as a Couple: 5 Methods That Work](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-split-expenses-as-a-couple.html): Covers 50/50, proportional, category-based, joint account, and single-payer methods with a decision framework.
- [Couple Budget Planning Guide](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/couple-budget-planning.html): Choose a money model, pick a split method, set up weekly and monthly money check-ins.
- [Couples Financial Planning for Beginners](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/couples-financial-planning-for-beginners.html): First money conversation, financial transparency, shared goals, emergency fund, debt payoff, and a scalable money routine.
- [How to Divide Household Chores Fairly](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-divide-chores-as-a-couple.html): 4 division methods, task inventory including invisible labor, ownership rules, and handling chore arguments.
- [Shared Calendar for Couples: Best Setup and Rules](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/shared-calendar-for-couples.html): How to set up a shared calendar, color-coding, 5 rules every couple should agree on, app comparison.
- [How to Coordinate Schedules as a Couple](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-coordinate-schedules-as-a-couple.html): Schedule mapping, anchor routines, weekly sync, protecting quality time, handling shift work.
- [How to Build a Relationship Planning System](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/relationship-planning-system.html): The 3 planning layers (monthly goals, weekly commitments, daily execution), shared categories, task ownership.
- [Weekly Couple Planning Meeting (30-Minute Template)](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/weekly-couple-planning-meeting.html): Minute-by-minute agenda for your weekly couple check-in.
- [How to Set Goals as a Couple](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-set-goals-as-a-couple.html): Quarterly goal-setting system covering 6 categories with planning session template and retrospectives.
- [Moving In Together Checklist](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/moving-in-together-checklist.html): Week-by-week timeline from 8 weeks before the move to your first 90 days together.
- [Tandem vs Notion for Couples Planning](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/tandem-vs-notion-for-couples.html): Head-to-head comparison covering setup time, tasks, calendar, finances, and mobile experience.
- [Best Couples Planner App: What to Look For](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/best-couples-planner-app.html): How to evaluate couples planner apps — the 5 features that actually matter.
- [How to Manage Money as a Couple](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-manage-money-as-a-couple.html): Complete money management system using the 3-Account Method (Joint + Personal A + Personal B), shared money rules, spending thresholds, and routines.
- [How to Stop Fighting About Money](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-stop-fighting-about-money.html): The 5 Money Fight Triggers and the Conflict-to-System approach. Practical steps to turn recurring money arguments into shared systems.
- [How to Organize Your Household as a Couple](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-organize-your-household-as-a-couple.html): The 4-Zone Household System (Cleaning, Admin, Errands, Maintenance) with task inventories, ownership rules, and weekly syncs.
- [Couple Meal Planning: A Weekly System for Two](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/couple-meal-planning.html): The 3-2-1 Meal Plan framework, 20-minute weekly planning routine, shared recipe rotation, and batch cooking strategies.
- [How to Share a Grocery List With Your Partner](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/how-to-share-a-grocery-list-with-your-partner.html): The Add-Check-Shop Loop for shared grocery management, category organization, and comparison of shared list methods.
- [Communication Tips for Couples Who Plan Together](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/communication-tips-for-couples.html): The 4 Communication Modes (Inform, Request, Negotiate, Check-in) and how to use each one when planning and organizing as a couple.
- [First Apartment Together: Complete Setup Checklist](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/first-apartment-together-checklist.html): The First 30 Days System — week-by-week guide for setting up your first shared home, from essentials to routines.
- [Best Apps for Couples in 2026](https://tandem-app.eu/guides/best-apps-for-couples.html): Comprehensive comparison of couple apps across categories (organizers, calendars, expense splitting, to-do lists). Introduces the Couple App Stack concept.
